多亏二龙山三位兄弟援手，救得哥哥出来。只是黄信那厮逃了回去，青州必然发兵来打清风: Thanks to our three brothers from Twin Dragon Mountain, we got you out, brother. But that Huang Xin got away, and Qingzhou is sure to send troops against Qingfeng Mountain.
鲁大师、武二郎、杨制使已自回山。我等且在山下村坊补些药品，整顿兵器，提防官军。: Master Lu, Wu Song and Yang Zhi have gone back to their mountain. Let's restock medicine and ready our weapons in the village below, and watch for the army.
山寨里有的是金银，兄弟们只管去置办！: The stronghold has plenty of silver. Buy whatever you need, brothers!
武龙兄弟连夜报信，公明哥哥和戴院长定在江州十字路口问斩。晁头领已点起十七个兄弟，: Brother Wu Long rode through the night: Song Jiang and Dai Zong are to be executed at the Jiangzhou crossroads. Chief Chao has picked seventeen brothers in four groups, disguised as merchants, beggars, porters and street fighters.
（江州城里）铁牛自在城里等着，到时候从茶坊楼上跳下去，一斧一个！: (In Jiangzhou) Iron Ox will wait in the city, then leap from the teahouse roof and cut them down one by one!
诸位且在山上补齐药品，整顿兵器。下山之后，便要一路杀进江州了。: Restock medicine and ready your weapons here. Once we leave the mountain, we fight all the way into Jiangzhou.
哥哥受了一场惊恐。前面便是揭阳镇，小弟送哥哥一程，过了镇子再回岭上。: That was a fright, brother. Jieyang Town lies ahead; I'll see you through it before returning to the ridge.
多得兄弟相救。既如此，且在岭下店中补些药物，整顿了再走。: Thanks for the rescue, brother. Then let's restock at the inn below the ridge before moving on.
揭阳镇上有一霸，哥哥路过时休要与人争闲气。: There's a bully in Jieyang Town. Don't get into quarrels when you pass through, brother.
前面便是村镇。两位且补些衣药，整顿兵刃，再同大队上路。: A village lies ahead. You two restock and ready your weapons, then rejoin the main group.
也罢。眼前所除，先置办齐了。: Very well. Let's get what we need first.
也罢。眼前所需，先置办齐了。: Very well. Let's get what we need first.
买齐便走，休在此处耽搁。: Buy what we need and go. No dawdling.
前面便是孟州城。诸位先到街边补齐药品，整顿兵器，再去寻那三个主谋。: Mengzhou lies ahead. Restock medicine and ready your weapons, then we go after the three schemers.
好！买齐所除，便去鸳鸯楼问个明白，休叫那伙贼人又害旁人！: Good! Once we have what we need, we go to Mandarin Duck Tower to settle this, before those villains harm anyone else!
好！买齐所需，便去鸳鸯楼问个明白，休叫那伙贼人又害旁人！: Good! Once we have what we need, we go to Mandarin Duck Tower to settle this, before those villains harm anyone else!
二郎，你既要依文投营，哥哥不拦。只是孟州路远，我与武龙陪你走一程，也好从中照应。: Brother, if you insist on reporting to the prison camp as ordered, I won't stop you. But Mengzhou is far; Wu Long and I will go with you part of the way and look after you.
哥哥肯这般相待，武松感激不尽。只是不可坏了公人的差事。: I'm deeply grateful, brother. Just don't interfere with the guards' duty.
只照应盘缠行李，不劫官差。且在城中置办些衣药，再一同上路。: We'll only help with money and baggage, no robbing officials. Let's buy some supplies in town, then go together.

前方有个史家庄，庄主史太公是个乐善好施的人，他有个儿子好弄枪棒，先后拜了七、八名: Ahead is Shi Family Village. Squire Shi is a generous man. His son loves spear and staff, has studied under seven or eight masters, and is known as "Nine Dragons" Shi Jin.
过了华阴县界便是少华山，山上有三个强人，聚集着五七百个小喽罗打家劫舍。: Past the Huayin border is Mount Shaohua, where three outlaws lead five to seven hundred bandits in raiding homes.
前方有座桃花庄，庄主人称刘太公。刘太公有个女儿，年方十九，生得頗有些姿色。: Ahead is Peach Blossom Manor, home of Squire Liu. He has a daughter of nineteen, quite a beauty.
桃花庄附近有座桃花山，日前来了两个山大王，聚集了五七百人，扎了寨柵，四处打家劫舍: Near the manor is Peach Blossom Mountain. Two bandit kings arrived lately with five to seven hundred men, built a stockade, and raid all around.
两天前来了一个脾气暴躁的和尚，来小店又吃酒又吃肉，这人生得面圓耳大，鼻直口方，身: Two days ago a hot-tempered monk came in and ate meat and drank wine. Round face, big ears, straight nose, square mouth, eight feet tall and broad as a barrel, a head like bronze and a back like a tiger. When he finished he went on ahead, probably to Peach Blossom Village.
此下欲往延安府只有一条路，不过路上时有强盗出没，不甚安寧。: There's only one road from here to Yan'an, and robbers often haunt it. It's not very safe.
此下欲往延安府只有一条路，不过路上时有强盗出没，不甚安宁。: There's only one road from here to Yan'an, and robbers often haunt it. It's not very safe.
新任八十万禁军枪棒教头林冲是条好汉子，人称「豹子头」林冲。: Lin Chong, the new arms instructor of the eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards, is a fine fellow known as "Panther Head".
高俅膝下无子，因此把阿叔高三郎的儿子过继为子，这 甚得高俅寵爱，因此在东京倚势: Gao Qiu had no son, so he adopted his uncle's boy. Spoiled by Gao Qiu, he bullies all of Kaifeng and preys on other men's wives and daughters. Everyone fears his power, and who would dare cross him? They call him the "Playboy Lord", Young Master Gao.
前些时候柴大官人府上来了一个洪教头，自詡枪棒功夫无人能敌，頗得柴大官人礼遇。此人: Some time ago an Instructor Hong came to Lord Chai's manor, boasting no one could match his spear and staff. Lord Chai treats him well, but he's arrogant and looks down on everyone.
那个洪教头老是自吹自擂，说不定没什么真本事。: That Instructor Hong is always bragging. He may not have much real skill.
前方有个黄泥冈，冈上盗匪猖厥，即便是闲常太平时节，大白天里照样出来劫人。: Ahead is Yellow Mud Ridge. Bandits run wild there and rob people in broad daylight, even in peaceful times.
东溪村有位保正，姓晁名盖，人称「托塔天王」，平日仗义疏财，甚得村民爱戴。: East Creek Village has a headman named Chao Gai, known as the "Pagoda King". He is generous and much loved by the villagers.
这里是鄆城县，管下东门外有两个村坊︰一个东溪村，一个西溪村，两村只隔着一个大溪，: This is Yuncheng County. Outside the east gate are two villages, East Creek and West Creek, divided by a wide stream. West Creek was once haunted by ghosts that lured people into the water. A monk passing through told them to carve a pagoda of blue stone and set it by the creek, which drove the ghosts over to East Creek. Chao Gai was furious, waded across, and carried the stone pagoda to the east bank by himself. That's why everyone calls him the "Pagoda King".
鄆城县内有两位都头，一个唤作「美髯公」朱仝，一个唤作「插翅虎」雷横，此二人都与晁: Yuncheng has two constables: "Beautiful Beard" Zhu Tong and "Winged Tiger" Lei Heng. Both are friends of Chao Gai.
石碣村再过去便是梁山泊，由于地势险恶，易守难攻，山上聚集了七、八百名盗匪，声势日: Beyond Stone Tablet Village lies Liangshan Marsh. The terrain is easy to defend and hard to attack. Seven or eight hundred outlaws gather there, growing stronger daily; even the army dares not interfere.
梁山泊目前为首的头领人称「白衣秀士」王綸，听说不过是个落第秀才。: Liangshan's chief is called the "White-clad Scholar", Wang Lun. They say he's just a scholar who failed the exams.
梁山泊上有三名强人扎寨，聚集七八百个喽罗，做着没本钱的买卖。为首的头领是『白衣秀: Three outlaws hold Liangshan with seven or eight hundred men, in the business of taking without paying. The chief is "White-clad Scholar" Wang Lun, followed by "Sky Toucher" Du Qian and "Cloud Guardian" Song Wan.
听说那王伦似乎还頗讀了一些詩书，至于杜迁及宋万这两人自是粗鹵的渾人，没什么真本事: They say Wang Lun has read a fair bit, but Du Qian and Song Wan are just rough brutes with no real skill.
前面那个林子名叫『野猪林』，是从东京往沧州最险峻的地方。因地势险恶,林中浓霧密布: The forest ahead is Wild Boar Forest, the most dangerous stretch between Kaifeng and Cangzhou. Treacherous ground and thick fog make it perfect for ambushes. They say guards are often bribed to bring prisoners here, and who knows how many good men have died in it.
王教头！我们要不要冲出去？: Instructor Wang! Should we break out?

此后可走关西正路或山林小径往延安府，大哥意欲何往？: From here we can take the main Guanxi road or the mountain trail to Yan'an. Which way, brother?
走正路或许会碰到官兵，不过山中拦路强人也不少，倒不如咱们就正大光明的走关西正路吧: The main road may have soldiers, but the mountains are full of robbers too. Let's just take the Guanxi road openly!
走正路或许会碰到不少官兵沿路拦阻，不如咱们就走小径吧！: The main road may be blocked by soldiers. Let's take the trail!
大哥，此处前往沧州有两条路，我们该走哪条？: Brother, there are two roads to Cangzhou. Which should we take?
嗯...还是尽早抵达沧州的好，就走大道吧！: Hmm... better reach Cangzhou soon. The main road it is!
咱们还是不要太招搖的好，就走小径吧！: Better not draw attention. Let's take the trail!
